text:
Alex: Need recs for one-season shows to binge on a 6-hour flight + a few short graphic novels (<200 pages). low-drama, high-comfort please.
Priya: One-season shows: 'Fleabag' is 2 short seasons but each ep is ~25 min, very bingeable. For single-season comfort, 'The End of the F***ing World' is dark but quick.
Ben: If you want soft comfort one-off: 'The Baby-Sitters Club' (S1) is warm and ~20min eps. Also 'Russian Doll' S1 feels contained and satisfying.
Nora: For low stakes and laughs: 'Galavant' (musical, 1 season-ish vibe) or 'Enlightened' S1 vibes.
Kai: Graphic novels: "Daytripper" ~160p, beautiful and not heavy. Also "The Prince and the Dressmaker" is ~240 though slightly over.
Priya: Short comics: 'Asterios Polyp' is denser but single-sitting; not everyone likes it on a plane. For pure sweetness: 'Local Girl Missing' (mini-comic) or 'The Tea Dragon Society' (light, ~120p).
Alex: Love Daytripper rec — thanks. Any audio-first recs? like audio dramas or short podcasts for plane without wifi?
Ben: 'Homecoming' has a tight single-season arc and is great as podcast audio. Also check Radiotopia minis.
Nora: If you want something to drift in/out of: Planet Money episodes are short and oddly relaxing.
Echo (bot): Sticker pack suggestion: "plane-books" :books: added to thread.
Kai: Another graphic novella: 'My Favorite Thing Is Monsters' is great but darker. 'The Black Friend' (short, essay comic) is under 150.
Priya: For comedy comfort shows: 'Aislings' Diary' or 'Detectorists' (S1 episodes ~30min) are cozy and mellow.
Alex: This is perfect. saved a list. If anyone has dumbly cheerful, low-effort romcom movies under 2 hours, toss them here too.
Ben: 'The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society' is gentle, ~2h. 'What If' (Netflix) is playful ~1h45.
Nora: 'Before Sunrise' is 100% plane-friendly if you're in a mellow mood.
Alex: Thanks y'all. packing headphones and Daytripper. will report if I finish a full graphic novel mid-air. :airplane:
Priya: Safe travels! post an in-flight snack pic pls. :pretzel:
Alex: Will do :camera_with_flash:
